---
title: "Georgia's EPA was positive in every quarter while Missouri spent the game climbing out of its first"
date: "2026-11-18"
description: "Play-by-play expected points show Georgia adding value in all four quarters while Missouri's offense dug a first-quarter hole it climbed out of but never closed, and the play text lets individual defenders claim the disruption events behind it."
followups:
  - "Scale the play-text disruption parse across all 2026 seasons to build a defender-level disruption EPA leaderboard."
  - "Fit a fixed-effects model of run EPA with offense, defense and rusher terms to estimate offensive and defensive line unit strength for every 2026 team."
  - "Weight the passer and receiver EPA split by air yards instead of an even 50/50 share."
author:
  - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
freeze: auto
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Georgia's EPA was positive in every quarter while Missouri spent the game climbing out of its first}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{.r .cell-code}
# ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults -------------------------
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)

# ---- Load the tables -------------------------------------------------------
teams <- dbReadTable(con, "teams")
team_colors <- team_color_values(teams)
home_team <- "Georgia"
away_team <- "Missouri"
two_cols <- team_colors[c(home_team, away_team)]
names(two_cols) <- c(home_team, away_team)

# The game: 2026 week 11, Georgia vs Missouri at Sanford Stadium.
g_plays <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM plays WHERE gameId = 401856883 ORDER BY id"
)
game_row <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT homeTeam, awayTeam, homePoints, awayPoints, season, week ",
    "FROM games WHERE id = 401856883"
  )
)
final_home <- game_row$homePoints
final_away <- game_row$awayPoints

# ---- Scrimmage plays and expected points -----------------------------------
# A scrimmage play is a run or a pass attempt; kickoffs, punts, field goals,
# penalties without a play and period breaks carry no EPA and are excluded.
kick_types <- c(
  "Kickoff",
  "Kickoff Return (Offense)",
  "Kickoff Return Touchdown",
  "Punt",
  "Punt Return (Offense)",
  "Punt Return (Defension)",
  "Punt Return (Defensive)",
  "Punt Return Touchdown",
  "Field Goal Good",
  "Field Goal Missed",
  "Blocked Field Goal",
  "Extra Point Good",
  "Extra Point Missed",
  "Blocked Extra Point",
  "Two-Point Pass",
  "Two-Point Rush",
  "Two-Point Return",
  "Uncategorized",
  "End Period",
  "Timeout",
  "Penalty"
)
scr <- g_plays |>
  filter(!playType %in% kick_types) |>
  arrange(driveNumber, playNumber) |>
  mutate(seq = row_number())
n_scr <- nrow(scr)
n_na_ppa <- sum(is.na(scr$ppa))

# An expected points model fit on every 2026 scrimmage play: the target is the
# net points the offense scored over the rest of the half, anchored on the
# home-away score differential so both teams' rows read from one perspective.
h26 <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, defense,",
    " home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, down,",
    " distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa",
    " FROM plays WHERE season = 2026"
  )
) |>
  filter(
    !playType %in% kick_types,
    down > 0,
    !is.na(yardsToGoal),
    !is.na(distance),
    !is.na(down)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    half = if_else(period <= 2L, 1L, 2L),
    home_diff = if_else(
      offense == home,
      offenseScore - defenseScore,
      defenseScore - offenseScore
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(gameId, half) |>
  arrange(driveNumber, playNumber, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    final_diff = last(home_diff),
    y_pre = final_diff - home_diff
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(y_off = y_pre * if_else(offense == home, 1L, -1L))
off_td <- c("Rushing Touchdown", "Passing Touchdown")
def_td <- c(
  "Interception Return Touchdown",
  "Punt Return Touchdown",
  "Kickoff Return Touchdown",
  "Fumble Return Touchdown"
)
# Scoring plays already carry their points in the row's score; shift the
# target back to the pre-play state. A touchdown row shows the six points but
# not yet the extra point, so seven folds the expected kick into the target.
h26 <- h26 |>
  mutate(
    pts_off = case_when(
      playType %in% off_td ~ 7,
      playType == "Safety" ~ 2,
      playType %in% def_td ~ -7,
      playType == "Field Goal" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    pts_home = pts_off * if_else(offense == home, 1L, -1L),
    y_pre = final_diff - (home_diff - pts_home),
    y_off = y_pre * if_else(offense == home, 1L, -1L)
  )
library(splines)
ep_fit <- lm(
  y_off ~ ns(yardsToGoal, df = 8) *
    factor(down) +
    ns(distance, df = 4) +
    factor(down):ns(distance, df = 3),
  data = h26
)
ep_r2 <- summary(ep_fit)$r.squared

# EP before and after each play of the game, and the model's own EPA.
ep_from <- function(ytg, dn, dist) {
  dn <- pmin(pmax(as.integer(dn), 1L), 4L)
  predict(
    ep_fit,
    data.frame(
      yardsToGoal = max(0, min(99, ytg)),
      down = dn,
      distance = dist
    )
  )
}
gp3 <- scr |>
  mutate(
    td_off = playType %in% off_td,
    # "Fumble" means the fumble was not lost; a lost fumble is recovered by
    # the opponent and carries its own play type.
    turnover = playType == "Pass Interception Return" |
      playType == "Fumble Recovery (Opponent)",
    incomplete = playType == "Pass Incompletion",
    ep_before = ep_from(yardsToGoal, down, distance),
    ytg2 = yardsToGoal - yardsGained,
    ep_after = case_when(
      td_off ~ 6.94,
      turnover ~ -ep_from(100 - yardsToGoal, 1L, 10),
      incomplete & down < 4 ~ ep_from(yardsToGoal, down + 1L, distance),
      incomplete ~ -ep_from(100 - yardsToGoal, 1L, 10),
      ytg2 <= 0 ~ 6.94,
      distance - yardsGained <= 0 ~ ep_from(ytg2, 1L, min(10, ytg2)),
      down + 1 > 4 ~ -ep_from(100 - ytg2, 1L, 10),
      .default = ep_from(ytg2, down + 1L, distance - yardsGained)
    ),
    epa_mine = ep_after - ep_before
  )
epa_cor <- cor(gp3$epa_mine, gp3$ppa, use = "complete.obs")

# ---- 3.1 Cumulative and rolling EPA ----------------------------------------
cum_ppa <- gp3 |>
  filter(!is.na(ppa)) |>
  group_by(offense) |>
  arrange(seq, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(play_n = row_number(), cum_ppa = cumsum(ppa)) |>
  ungroup()
roll_ppa <- gp3 |>
  filter(!is.na(ppa)) |>
  group_by(offense) |>
  arrange(seq, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    play_n = row_number(),
    # trailing ten-play mean, partial at the start
    roll = (cumsum(ppa) - dplyr::lag(cumsum(ppa), 10, default = 0)) /
      pmin(row_number(), 10)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
tot_epa <- gp3 |>
  filter(!is.na(ppa)) |>
  group_by(offense) |>
  summarise(total = sum(ppa), plays = n(), per_play = mean(ppa))
ga_tot <- tot_epa$total[tot_epa$offense == home_team]
mz_tot <- tot_epa$total[tot_epa$offense == away_team]
ga_per <- tot_epa$per_play[tot_epa$offense == home_team]
mz_per <- tot_epa$per_play[tot_epa$offense == away_team]

# ---- 3.2 Quarterly decomposition -------------------------------------------
explosive_threshold <- 1.5
band_exp <- paste0("Explosive play (EPA ", explosive_threshold, "+)")
band_ord <- paste0("Ordinary play (EPA 0 to ", explosive_threshold, ")")
band_neg <- "Negative play (EPA below 0)"
qtr_split <- gp3 |>
  filter(!is.na(ppa)) |>
  mutate(
    quarter = paste0("Q", period),
    band = case_when(
      ppa >= explosive_threshold ~ band_exp,
      ppa >= 0 ~ band_ord,
      .default = band_neg
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(offense, quarter, band) |>
  summarise(epa = sum(ppa), n_plays = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(quarter = factor(quarter, paste0("Q", 1:4)))
q_share <- qtr_split |>
  group_by(offense, quarter) |>
  mutate(q_total = sum(epa)) |>
  ungroup()
# quarterly totals, the cumulative path and the closest Missouri ever got
q_tot <- q_share |>
  select(offense, quarter, q_total) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = quarter, values_from = q_total)
ga_q_min <- min(as.numeric(unlist(q_tot[q_tot$offense == home_team, -1])))
mz_cum_by_q <- cumsum(as.numeric(unlist(q_tot[q_tot$offense == away_team, -1])))
mz_min_cum <- min(mz_cum_by_q)
min_gap <- min(
  as.numeric(unlist(q_tot[q_tot$offense == home_team, -1])) -
    mz_cum_by_q
)
mz_cross_q <- paste0("Q", which(mz_cum_by_q > 0)[1])
# the fourth-quarter split for the prose
q4_split <- q_share |>
  filter(offense == away_team, quarter == "Q4") |>
  select(band, epa, n_plays)
mz_q4_exp <- q4_split$epa[q4_split$band == band_exp]
mz_q4_ord <- q4_split$epa[q4_split$band == band_ord]
mz_q1_neg <- q_share |>
  filter(offense == away_team, quarter == "Q1", band == band_neg) |>
  pull(epa)

# ---- 3.3 Drive outcomes ----------------------------------------------------
# One row per drive: the possession team, its starting field position, the
# points it scored and its total EPA. A drive ends in points when the
# possession team's score rises across the drive; a scoreless drive that gave
# the ball away on its last scrimmage play is a turnover.
drive_frame <- g_plays |>
  filter(offense %in% c(home_team, away_team)) |>
  group_by(driveId) |>
  arrange(id, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  summarise(
    offense = first(offense),
    start_ytg = first(yardsToGoal),
    points = last(offenseScore) - first(offenseScore),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(start_ytg), points >= 0) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      points >= 6 ~ "Touchdown",
      points == 3 ~ "Field goal",
      .default = "No score"
    )
  )
turnover_ends <- gp3 |>
  filter(turnover) |>
  group_by(driveId) |>
  slice_max(seq, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pull(driveId)
drive_epa <- gp3 |>
  filter(!is.na(ppa)) |>
  group_by(driveId) |>
  summarise(drive_epa = sum(ppa), .groups = "drop")
first_seq <- scr |>
  group_by(driveId) |>
  summarise(seq0 = min(seq), .groups = "drop")
to_df <- tibble::tibble(driveId = turnover_ends, to = TRUE)
drives <- drive_frame |>
  left_join(to_df, by = "driveId") |>
  mutate(
    outcome = if_else(
      outcome == "No score" & !is.na(to),
      "Turnover",
      outcome
    )
  ) |>
  select(-to) |>
  left_join(drive_epa, by = "driveId") |>
  left_join(first_seq, by = "driveId") |>
  arrange(seq0) |>
  mutate(drive_n = row_number())
out_palette <- c(
  "Touchdown" = "#15803d",
  "Field goal" = "#65a30d",
  "No score" = "#9ca3af",
  "Turnover" = "#b91c1c"
)
n_ga_td <- sum(drives$outcome == "Touchdown" & drives$offense == home_team)
n_mz_td <- sum(drives$outcome == "Touchdown" & drives$offense == away_team)

# ---- 3.4 Defensive disruption ledger ---------------------------------------
# The play text names the defender responsible on sacks, tackles for loss and
# stuffs, as "(#N Surname)". Credit the offense's lost EPA on those plays to
# the named defender. The display name is exactly what the text printed.
disrupt <- gp3 |>
  filter(!is.na(ppa)) |>
  filter(playType == "Sack" | (playType == "Rush" & yardsGained <= 0)) |>
  mutate(
    tackler = str_extract(playText, "\\(#[0-9]+\\s+[^)]*\\)"),
    credit = if_else(is.na(tackler), NA_character_, str_sub(tackler, 2, -2))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(credit)) |>
  transmute(
    offense,
    seq,
    period,
    credit,
    event = if_else(playType == "Sack", "Sack", "Tackle for loss or stuff"),
    epa_swing = -ppa
  )
int_names <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT playId, athleteName FROM play_stats ",
    "WHERE gameId = 401856883 AND statType = 'Interception'"
  )
)
int_plays <- gp3 |>
  filter(turnover) |>
  transmute(
    offense,
    seq,
    period,
    event = "Interception",
    epa_swing = -ppa,
    playId = id
  ) |>
  left_join(int_names, by = "playId") |>
  mutate(
    credit = if_else(
      is.na(athleteName),
      "Unnamed defender",
      paste0(athleteName, " (return)")
    )
  ) |>
  select(offense, seq, period, credit, event, epa_swing)
ledger <- bind_rows(disrupt, int_plays) |>
  arrange(seq)
ledger_sum <- ledger |>
  group_by(defense = if_else(offense == home_team, away_team, home_team)) |>
  summarise(events = n(), epa_swing = sum(epa_swing))
ga_def_swing <- ledger_sum$epa_swing[ledger_sum$defense == home_team]
mz_def_swing <- ledger_sum$epa_swing[ledger_sum$defense == away_team]

# ---- 3.5 Model agreement ---------------------------------------------------
agree_pts <- gp3 |> filter(!is.na(ppa))

# ---- inline numbers for the prose ------------------------------------------
ga_gap <- ga_tot - mz_tot
n_lev_events <- nrow(ledger)
# share of each offense's negative EPA that the credited events explain
neg_faced <- gp3 |>
  filter(!is.na(ppa)) |>
  group_by(offense) |>
  summarise(neg = -sum(pmin(ppa, 0)), .groups = "drop")
ga_off_neg <- neg_faced$neg[neg_faced$offense == home_team]
mz_off_neg <- neg_faced$neg[neg_faced$offense == away_team]
share_mz_def <- 100 * mz_def_swing / ga_off_neg
share_ga_def <- 100 * ga_def_swing / mz_off_neg
# drives that could not be scored
n_dropped <- nrow(drive_frame) - nrow(drives)
n_drive_total <- nrow(drive_frame)
# the closest the trailing team came after crossing zero
ga_cum_q <- cumsum(as.numeric(unlist(q_tot[q_tot$offense == home_team, -1])))
cross_i <- which(mz_cum_by_q > 0)[1]
min_gap_post <- min(
  ga_cum_q[cross_i:length(ga_cum_q)] -
    mz_cum_by_q[cross_i:length(mz_cum_by_q)]
)
```

in this post is computed from the published database; expected points come
from a model fit on all 190,135 2026 scrimmage plays.*

## 1. Introduction

Expected points (EP) is the number of points the offense is expected to net
over the rest of the half given down, distance and field position. Expected
points added (EPA) is the difference between the EP after a play and the EP
before it, so one play's outcome becomes one number in points. Reading
Georgia 48, Missouri 21, the week 11
meeting at Sanford Stadium, play by play, turns the final score into a
sequence of value that shows who controlled the game and when it was
decided.

+ *Georgia's cumulative EPA rose in every quarter.*
+ *Missouri's cumulative EPA stayed below zero until the third quarter and never closed the gap.*
+ *The defenses' contributions show up as named disruption events in the play text.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Every value number rests on the same idea, applied play by play

```{.r .cell-code}
  "Cumulative EPA"       , "The running sum of a team's EPA over its own plays, in game order."                                                                            ,
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Georgia's cumulative EPA rose in every quarter while Missouri never closed its first-quarter gap

*Expectation: Georgia's cumulative EPA climbs steadily; Missouri's stays
below zero until the third quarter and never gets close again.* ✅

Georgia's running total climbs from its first play; Missouri's dips to
-15.1 EPA and spends the rest of the game climbing out of
that hole. The bottom panel smooths the same plays into a ten-play rolling
average, the play-by-play read of who was better right now. Hover any point
for the play behind it.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tt <- function(df) {
  df$tip <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    df$offense,
    "</b> play ",
    df$play_n,
    "<br>",
    df$playText,
    "<br>EPA: ",
    round(df$ppa, 2)
  )
  df
}
# A per-row tooltip splits an interactive line into one-point groups, so the
# lines carry a constant per-team tooltip and the per-play detail lives on
# the points instead.
p_cum <- ggplot(tt(cum_ppa), aes(play_n, cum_ppa, color = offense)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_step_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = paste0(offense, ": cumulative EPA")),
    linewidth = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), size = 0.4, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.5, se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = two_cols, name = "Offense") +
  labs(y = "Cumulative EPA", x = NULL) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
p_roll <- ggplot(tt(roll_ppa), aes(play_n, roll, color = offense)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = paste0(offense, ": rolling EPA per play")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = two_cols, name = "Offense") +
  labs(y = "Rolling EPA per play (10 plays)", x = "Plays run by that offense") +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p_cum / p_roll, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 7)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
tt2 <- function(df) {
  df$tip <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    df$offense,
    " ",
    df$quarter,
    "</b><br>",
    df$band,
    ": ",
    fmt(df$epa, 1),
    " EPA over ",
    df$n_plays,
    " plays"
  )
  df
}
band_cols <- c(band_exp = "#15803d", band_ord = "#a3a3a3", band_neg = "#b91c1c")
names(band_cols) <- c(band_exp, band_ord, band_neg)
p_bands <- q_share |>
  tt2() |>
  ggplot(aes(quarter, epa, fill = band)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~offense) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = band_cols,
    name = NULL,
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "EPA in the quarter",
    x = NULL,
    title = "Where each quarter's value came from"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p_bands, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 5.5)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
tt3 <- function(df) {
  df$tip <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    df$offense,
    " drive ",
    df$drive_n,
    "</b><br>",
    df$outcome,
    ", ",
    df$points,
    " pts<br>",
    "Started ",
    df$start_ytg,
    " yards from the end zone<br>",
    "Drive EPA: ",
    round(df$drive_epa, 2)
  )
  df
}
p_drives <- drives |>
  tt3() |>
  ggplot(aes(drive_n, start_ytg, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), width = 0.85, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~offense, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = out_palette,
    name = "Drive outcome",
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    x = "Drive number (in game order)",
    y = "Yards from the end zone at the start"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p_drives, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 5)
```

### 3.4 Named defenders account for every credited disruption event in the game

*Expectation: the credited events carry a large share of the negative EPA
each defense forced.* ✅

The play text names the defender on sacks, tackles for loss and stuffs, and
the play-by-play stat log names the interceptor. Each such event destroys
EPA for the offense, and the table credits that destroyed value to the named
defender. Hover the bars for the plays behind each name.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ledger |>
  transmute(
    `Offense facing` = offense,
    Quarter = paste0("Q", period),
    `Credited defender` = credit,
    Event = event,
    `EPA destroyed` = round(epa_swing, 2)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Every credited disruption event in the game, in order.")
```

```{.r .cell-code}
ledger_bar <- ledger |>
  group_by(credit, event) |>
  summarise(epa_swing = sum(epa_swing), plays = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      "<b>",
      credit,
      "</b><br>",
      plays,
      " ",
      tolower(event),
      " event(s)<br>",
      fmt(epa_swing, 2),
      " EPA destroyed"
    )
  )
p_ledger <- ggplot(
  ledger_bar,
  aes(epa_swing, reorder(credit, epa_swing), fill = event)
) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sack" = "#b91c1c",
      "Tackle for loss or stuff" = "#9ca3af",
      "Interception" = "#7c3aed"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "EPA destroyed by credited events",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Who disrupted, by EPA destroyed"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p_ledger, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 5)
```

Missouri's defense destroyed 2.5 EPA, which is
18 percent of the negative EPA Georgia's offense
suffered, and Georgia's defense destroyed 9.8 EPA,
45 percent of what Missouri's offense lost. The
events are a floor: pressures without sacks and run defense without a
tackle for loss earn no credit.

### 3.5 A simple expected points model reproduces the data source's play-level EPA at a correlation of 0.85

*Expectation: the EPA numbers in this post do not depend on whose model
produced them.* ✅

The scatter sets each play's simple-model EPA against the provider EPA. The
two agree on the shape of the game; the largest gaps sit on the biggest
plays, where a down-distance-field-position model compresses extremes.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tt4 <- function(df) {
  df$tip <- paste0(
    "<b>",
    df$offense,
    "</b><br>",
    df$playText,
    "<br>Provider EPA: ",
    round(df$ppa, 2),
    "<br>Simple-model EPA: ",
    round(df$epa_mine, 2)
  )
  df
}
p_agree <- agree_pts |>
  tt4() |>
  ggplot(aes(ppa, epa_mine, color = offense)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "22") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_color_manual(values = two_cols, name = "Offense") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-6, 7), ylim = c(-6, 7)) +
  labs(
    x = "Provider play EPA",

    title = paste0(
      "Two estimates of the same quantity, correlation ",
      round(epa_cor, 2)
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p_agree, width_svg = 9, height_svg = 6)
```

## 4. Summary

The game's value story is one of steady accumulation against a long stretch
underwater, and the play text supplies the defenders behind the stopping.

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The rolling EPA panel separates *who was better* from *who scored*: Missouri
was the better offense by EPA per play over stretches of the second half
without ever closing the cumulative gap Georgia built in the first quarter.
A defense can lose the game in the first quarter while winning stretches
after it.

- The disruption ledger is a floor, not a ceiling: pressures without sacks
  and run defense without a tackle for loss earn no credit here.
:::

Caveats: the expected points model is a spline fit on down, distance and
field position only, so it ignores clock, timeouts and score context, and a
single game rests on 128 scrimmage plays. The disruption parse
reads one defender per play even when two shared the tackle, and it takes
the name the text prints; the interception and the sack check out against
the play-by-play stat log, but the tackle-for-loss names cannot be
cross-checked because the roster table carries no names. The offensive line
remains invisible to play-level attribution in this data, unit-level
proxies aside.
